安娜的生活方式(Anna's Way of Living): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:安娜的经历、感受与成长。

Anna has practiced tennis for three years and won a prize last term. Leo advised Anna to try swimming as a new hobby. People around Anna often share different ideas about the forest path. What's more, the new motorway halved travel time.

Little by little, things began to change. Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The plant garden has become an important part of daily life. The towering saguaro cactus bloomed after the rains.

On Monday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Anna prefers sunny weather when running in the gym. In fact, the gallery's Italianate columns remind me of villas in Tuscany.

The forest path looked quieter than usual that evening. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. In fact, she wore neat pigtails to the school photo.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit.
